pkgmetadata.longdescription:
AMD's LLVM fork, as shipped with ROCm. Built from the same ROCm/llvm-project source archive that dev-libs/rocm-device-libs, dev-libs/rocm-comgr and dev-util/hipcc already consume, so it adds no new distfile.
This exists because the ROCm math libraries cannot be compiled by a vanilla LLVM: AMD's fork carries device-code changes that upstream LLVM does not have, notably bf16 signatures for the WMMA intrinsics and AMDGPU assembler support for source modifiers that vanilla rejects. Installed to a private prefix so it never competes with llvm-core/llvm.
